environment.seed_policy: different map seed; fixed algorithm seed; fresh learner/cache per run
environment.demand_policy: unchanged env.py random choice from config.required_mbs
environment.metric: len(final MILP-verified incumbent coverage), not generation average

initialization: Shared centre x/y, random h/theta for warm-up; uniform full-domain thereafter
scope: Shared exact scoring/weight learner; no surrogate, WE survival or CMA
restart_policy: Completed maps skipped; interrupted map restarts with the same seed
